title: Terms of Sale for Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards, Including Corporate Orders
content:
### Terms

(a) Buying any of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards earns no Finch Circle points, and Finch Notes cannot pay for any card.

(b) A card purchase whose value in one transaction is at or above the fraud review trigger of its kind is held for fraud review. The trigger is $1000.00 for the Marlowe & Finch Gift Card and the Marlowe & Finch eGift Card and $10000.00 for the Corporate Gift Card; no trigger applies to the Merchandise Credit Card, the Registry Reward Card or the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card.

(c) A corporate order of Corporate Gift Cards contains at least 10 cards. A corporate order whose value is at or above $5000.00 receives a volume discount of 3 percent.

### Schedule

| Card kind | Earns Finch Circle points when bought | Payable with Finch Notes | Fraud review trigger, one transaction | Minimum cards per corporate order | Corporate volume discount | Corporate order value for the discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | No | No | $1000.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | No | No | $1000.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Merchandise Credit Card | No | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Registry Reward Card | No | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Corporate Gift Card | No | No | $10000.00 | 10 | 3 percent | $5000.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | No | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

### Hypothetical orders

| Hypothetical order | Cards | Order value | Volume discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 Corporate Gift Cards of $500.00 | 9 | $4500.00 | Below the 10-card minimum for a corporate order |
| 40 Corporate Gift Cards of $125.00 | 40 | $5000.00 | 3 percent, the value being exactly at $5000.00: $150.00 off |
| 20 Corporate Gift Cards of $249.95 | 20 | $4999.00 | None; below $5000.00 |

Working of the second order: 40 cards of $125.00 each total $5000.00; 3 percent of $5000.00 is $150.00.

For fraud review, a hypothetical single transaction buying Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards to a value of exactly $1000.00 is at the trigger and is held; one of $999.99 is below it.
